figures.title: The saved path does not change between waves
figures.desc: Structured input, saved steps, validation, routing, receipt, and terminal state stay the same path on both waves. Only the rule file may change later.
figures.caption: Run the same saved path on both waves.
figures.transcript: Structured input, saved steps, validation, routing, receipt, and terminal state stay the same path on both waves. Only the rule file may change later.

figures.title: Invalid items stop in the open
figures.desc: An invalid item does not get a silent default. It stops in the open as OPEN or HOLD, visible on the receipt.
figures.caption: An invalid item stops in the open. It does not get a silent default.
figures.transcript: An invalid item does not get a silent default. It stops in the open as OPEN or HOLD, visible on the receipt.

items.label: Stop in the open
items.detail: OPEN or HOLD on the receipt

figures.title: Only RULE.md changes
figures.desc: The one-rule change overwrites RULE.md only. The path, the lots, and the receipts script stay put.
figures.caption: Copy the one-rule change onto RULE.md only.
figures.transcript: The one-rule change overwrites RULE.md only. The path, the lots, and the receipts script stay put.

figures.title: AUTHORIZED is READY; everything else is OPEN
figures.desc: Under the baseline rule, AUTHORIZED maps to READY. Every other status maps to OPEN.
figures.caption: Under the baseline, AUTHORIZED is READY. Everything else is OPEN.
figures.transcript: Under the baseline rule, AUTHORIZED maps to READY. Every other status maps to OPEN.

figures.title: PENDING becomes NOT_AUTHORIZED
figures.desc: After the rule change, PENDING maps to NOT_AUTHORIZED. AUTHORIZED still maps to READY.
figures.caption: After the rule change, PENDING is NOT_AUTHORIZED.
figures.transcript: After the rule change, PENDING maps to NOT_AUTHORIZED. AUTHORIZED still maps to READY.

figures.title: Only the PENDING lots move
figures.desc: AUTHORIZED and other lots are unchanged then byte-identical. PENDING lots move from OPEN to NOT_AUTHORIZED under the rule. RACK_CONFLICT lots stay RESOURCE_CONFLICT.
figures.caption: Only the PENDING lots move. AUTHORIZED and RACK lots stay byte-identical.
figures.transcript: AUTHORIZED and other lots are unchanged then byte-identical. PENDING lots move from OPEN to NOT_AUTHORIZED under the rule. RACK_CONFLICT lots stay RESOURCE_CONFLICT.

figures.title: Every lot ends with a visible disposition
figures.desc: Every lot ends with a visible disposition on the receipt. A missing terminal state is HOLD, not an implied pass.
figures.caption: Every lot must show a terminal disposition on the receipt.
figures.transcript: Every lot ends with a visible disposition on the receipt. A missing terminal state is HOLD, not an implied pass.

figures.title: Restore the baseline rule and prove it
figures.desc: Put the baseline RULE.md back. Rerun the saved path. The receipts match the baseline expected file.
figures.caption: Restore the baseline rule and prove the receipts match.
figures.transcript: Put the baseline RULE.md back. Rerun the saved path. The receipts match the baseline expected file.
